Preview login is intermittently rate-limited (multiple 429s), causing timeout waiting for login-form-email-input.

rca of the issue: RCA-1: Moderation persistence failure. Repro: coach logs in -> /connectgbb/feed -> click report, then admin -> /admin/feed -> click resolve. Observed 403 and Postgres 42501 with message 'new row violates row-level security policy for table community_audit_logs'; report/update does not persist. Mitigation: adjust RLS/policies/triggers for authenticated coach/admin workflow when writing community_post_reports and audit rows. RCA-2: Preview instability. Repro: run role-matrix script on preview URL; repeated 429 responses lead to timeout before login fields become interactable. Mitigation: allowlist/test bypass or reduce upstream rate limiting for automation traffic.
